source_change.compile_time_contract: Each method asserts four-byte object and function pointers. The build target remains MSVC Win32.

preserved_behavior.proof: For each source file, remove its one added declaration/definition block and the resulting normalized bytes exactly equal the base Git blob.
preserved_behavior.release: Existing actual object+4 InterlockedDecrement remains the sole source decrement, called once per non-null release operation. Provider zero dispatch is post-decrement only.

required_external_contract: Non-null payloads must be valid raw objects with an aligned four-byte intrusive counter at actual+4.
Current table words must be genuine callable addresses in this process; first-array objects need no-argument zero v+0, second-array objects also need v+8 taking one DWORD flag.
Any replacement installed during stop independently satisfies the raw layout, reference and lifetime contract.
Method-table targets and their contexts/allocators remain live through the call; providers do not access a receiver after the target returns.
Actual callbacks must not throw across the existing noexcept interface. Original exceptional native EH/SEH equivalence is not claimed.
Unknown second-array producer and actual runtime table/ownership admission remain unresolved. No empty-array or D5ABF8 assumption is made.
Current projected SoundInstance/SoundLevelEntry objects are not admitted as native-prefix objects. SoundChannelRuntime::release_reference would add another decrement.
Raw SoundSampleStorage currently carries numeric D5B074 identity plus its separate source scalar adapter. This new provider does not make that identity a callable table or replace its adapter.
GlobalConfigContext construction, shared manager/string bindings and outer-owner scalar dispatch remain separate integration obligations.
